description: This is a JUnit test class for the ImmutableSubjects class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It contains unit tests verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and behavior of methods like setSubject and removeSubject.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableSubjects, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and behavior for adding/removing subjects.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableSubjects instances are immutable and their fields are safely copied.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of equals and hashCode for ImmutableSubjects.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of ImmutableSubjects.

methods.name: createResourcesWithSamePathsShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures creating ImmutableSubjects with duplicate Subject IDs throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setExistingSubjectAgainReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that setting a subject that already exists returns the same instance.

methods.name: setSubjectReturnsNewExtendedObject
methods.description: Verifies that adding a new subject returns an extended ImmutableSubjects instance.

methods.name: removeSubjectReturnsNewReducedObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a subject returns a new ImmutableSubjects instance without that subject.

methods.name: removeNonExistingSubjectReturnsSameObject
methods.description: Ensures removing a non-existent subject returns the same instance.
